text: FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — VISITOR AND LEAVE POLICY (synthetic test data) Visitors are permitted from 4 PM to 7 PM Monday through Friday, and 10 AM to 6 PM Saturday and Sunday. FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — DISCIPLINARY AND SAFETY POLICY (synthetic test data) Quiet hours are 10 PM to 6 AM daily. Smoking, alcohol consumption and unauthorized electrical cooking appliances are prohibited in hostel rooms. For a first quiet-hours violation, the warden issues a written warning. A second quiet-hours violation attracts a 500 INR fine. Further violations are referred to the disciplinary committee;

a written warning. A second quiet-hours violation attracts a 500 INR fine. Further violations are referred to the disciplinary committee; no fixed additional fine is specified. Residents must report lost access cards to reception immediately. Replacement cards cost 200 INR. Damage to hostel property is charged at the documented repair cost. Damage to hostel property is charged at the documented repair cost. In a fire emergency, residents must evacuate using the nearest safe exit, avoid lifts and report to the designated assembly area. Report maintenance problems to the hostel office.

FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — HOSTEL FEE POLICY (synthetic test data) Academic year 2026–27. All amounts are in INR. Single room: 60000 per semester. Double sharing: 42000 per semester. Triple sharing: 30000 per semester. Mess fee: 18000 per semester for every resident. Refundable security deposit: 5000, paid once on first admission. Late payment attracts a flat 500 fee after the payment deadline

Refundable security deposit: 5000, paid once on first admission. Late payment attracts a flat 500 fee after the payment deadline of 15 July 2026. For cancellation before move-in, 90% of the room fee is refunded. Cancellation within 15 calendar days after move-in receives 50% of the room fee. After that, no room fee refund is available. after move-in receives 50% of the room fee. After that, no room fee refund is available. These percentages apply only to room fees. Security deposit is refunded within 30 days of checkout, less documented damage charges. Mess fee refund rules are not specified in this policy.

FICTIONAL UNIVERSITY — ROOM ALLOCATION POLICY (synthetic test data) Room allocation is managed by the hostel office. First-year students are normally allocated triple-sharing rooms. Returning students may request single or double-sharing rooms, subject to availability. Approved accessibility accommodations take priority over ordinary room preferences.
